description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git command behaviors regarding diff and merge-base operations. It sets up a Git repository with various branch structures and performs different diff commands to verify the behavior of symmetric diffs and merge-base options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the command to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines in a file to verify output length.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Cleans up or resets state after a test.
